rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Alan Knott-Craig
rows.Origin:
Bred by Anne G. Cocker (1920-2014) (Scotland, before 2014).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2008 as 'Alan Knott-Craig'.
rows.Bloom: Orange or orange-red. Orange-red; warm orange. Mild fragrance. Very double, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
